title: Redstone Arsenal FBI Lightning Protection
agency_path: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION.FBI - REDSTONE ARSENAL
detail_text: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) intends to issue a Request for Quote (RFQ) for the installation of a grounding rod and lightening protection cable on a gate and gate grab net at FBI’s North Campus at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama. This notice is not a request for quotes. The solicitation will be issued as a 100% Small Business set-aside. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code is 238210 Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors, and the applicable Small Business Size Standard, as established by the U.S. Small Business Administration, is $ 16.5 million. The magnitude of construction is estimated to be less than $25,000. In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul FAR 12.201-1(c)(2), the Government may solicit quotations directly from suppliers for this acquisition at or below the simplified acquisition threshold. Vendors that respond to this notice and provide a valid point of contact MAY BE issued the solicitation directly via email, however, response to this notice does not guarantee that your firm will receive the solicitation package. The Government reserves the right to determine the number of sources to be solicited. It is the vendor’s responsibility to notify the points of contact below of their interest in this requirement. The solicitation (RFQ) will be issued on or about March 16, 2026. Telephonic inquires will not be honored. If adequate competition is not received, the RFQ will be posted to SAM.gov. Interested vendors are encouraged to email the Contracting Officer, Amanda Mobley at almobley@fbi.gov and the Contract Specialist, Christine Munera at cmunera@fbi.gov. Ensure the subject of your email contains the words, “Lighting Protection North Campus.”
